t: 1960 Urago (Part II) | The Simplicity of Vintage Cycles
s: December 12, 2021 - There was so much to like when I acquired the Urago. All original. Original owner. All French. Although, the frame had been repainted sometime in the 80’s. And the drivetrain was a little odd (more below). And the headbadge was missing (now recreated). But, the owner had stories of rides and clearly had taken good care of the machine.
